name: Nebula Filaments
summary: Polish filament maker in Stare Bystre (Malopolska) that says it extrudes on Polish machines using its own granulate and dye recipes. It sells PREMIUM, TECH and ART lines plus the budget Colorfil brand, and offers private-label filament production.

oem_relationships.notes: nebulafilaments.com offers custom-branded filament production; no specific client brands identified.

product_lines.name: TECH PLA 607 / PLA 609 HD
product_lines.notes: Numbered technical PLA grades; differences not documented in the notes.

product_lines.name: ART PLA Thermo / Mystic Green
product_lines.notes: Thermochromic and colour-effect PLA; no thermochromic id exists.

product_lines.name: ART ABS Glowing / Marble / Thermo
product_lines.notes: Effect ABS; no glow, marble or thermo ABS ids exist.

product_lines.name: Colorfil
product_lines.notes: Nebula's own budget line; materials not detailed in the notes.

additional_notes: NIP 7352773408, REGON 123214332; address Stare Bystre 356, 34-407 Stare Bystre; legal form not stated. The site says raw materials come from established global polymer producers, with Nebula's own granulate and dye recipe. Czech retailer 3dstisk.com lists 'Eazyfil' next to Nebula, but the Nebula site does not mention Eazyfil, so the link is rumoured and uncorroborated. Not related to colorFabb's 'PLA Chameleon Nebula' or Siddament's 'nebula pla fix'. Distributed by Smart3D and others. Pricing is budget to mid (EU), so no single tier is given. TDS documents are available via SimplyPrint.

provenance.conflicts: Identity is high confidence. 3dstisk.com describes the filament as Czech-made, which conflicts with the company's own Polish-manufacturing statement; that claim is uncorroborated. The Eazyfil link is unverified.
